name: @polymarket-bot/research-worker
description: Research worker (WP-130, STORAGE-1): compacts verified WAL segments into checksummed Parquet and immutable dataset manifests; keeps the approximate research tier and exact pinned windows; and, only when explicitly executed, expires raw WAL after a verified extract (ADR-028, ADR-029). Holds no credential, opens no venue connection, and places no order.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __bundleCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bundleCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node ./dist/main.mjs
